principles.name: Consent and choice
principles.description: Empowering PII principals with choices and obtaining explicit or freely given consent for data collection and processing.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Consentimiento (Art. 5 Ley 29733 y Art. 7 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Purpose legitimacy and specification
principles.description: Ensuring that the processing of PII is lawful, determined, explicit and legitimate for specific business objectives.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Legalidad y Principio de Finalidad (Arts. 4 y 6 Ley 29733, Art. 8 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Collection limitation
principles.description: Limiting the collection of PII to that which is strictly necessary for specified purposes and obtained by lawful and fair means.

principles.name: Data minimization
principles.description: Minimizing the volume and sensitivity of PII processed, applying anonymization, pseudonymization and reduction techniques.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Proporcionalidad (Art. 7 Ley 29733 y Art. 9 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Use, retention and disclosure limitation
principles.description: Retaining PII only for as long as necessary, preventing secondary uses, and enforcing strict data disposal upon expiration.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Calidad y Principio de Finalidad (Arts. 6 y 8 Ley 29733, Art. 9 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Accuracy and quality
principles.description: Ensuring that PII processed is accurate, complete, up-to-date and reliable for the purposes of its processing.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Calidad (Art. 8 Ley 29733 y Art. 9 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Openness, transparency and notice
principles.description: Providing clear, easily accessible information regarding PII policies, notices, practices, and identity of the data controller.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Información (Art. 18 Ley 29733 y Art. 13 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Individual participation and access
principles.description: Providing mechanisms for PII principals to access, correct, delete, block, or contest the processing of their personal data (ARCO).
principles.ley_29733_principle: Derechos ARCO (Arts. 19-24 Ley 29733 y Arts. 47-58 D.S. 003-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Accountability
principles.description: Demonstrating proactive compliance, appointing DPOs/CPOs, recording processing activities, and managing vendor compliance.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Deber de Diligencia y Registro de Bancos de Datos (Arts. 27 y 31 Ley 29733)

principles.name: Information security
principles.description: Protecting PII with technical and organizational measures against unauthorized access, destruction, loss, alteration or breach.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Principio de Seguridad y Deber de Confidencialidad (Arts. 9 y 17 Ley 29733, R.D. 019-2013-JUS)

principles.name: Privacy compliance
principles.description: Verifying and monitoring compliance with applicable privacy legislation, internal policies, security baseline and audit requirements.
principles.ley_29733_principle: Sujeción a la Fiscalización de la ANPD (Arts. 32-35 Ley 29733)
